scientific_limits: Joint coupling and endpoint changed together in R53; their individual effect is not established.
R53 GPU generation and historical R49 CPU comparison are not a matched-platform causal test.
Source Q marginal differs from REAL and remains preserved; continuous Q conditioning cannot repair that marginal.
Existing Q-only classifier evidence is inconclusive; no impossibility claim is established.
All DEV evidence is historically exposed; no independent acquisition or final EVAL opened.

next_mechanism_evidence.fact: The network receives normalized waveform guide, scalar time and eight-bin code. Absolute source Q scales external coordinates and noise, but exact continuous Q is not supplied directly to the learned field.
next_mechanism_evidence.hypothesis: Within-bin charge dependence of normalized target pulse/noise may be incompletely represented. This is a testable hypothesis, not an established cause of the R53 failures.
